title: Israeli Strikes Kill Seven Across Gaza; IDF Says It Killed Senior Hamas Security Official
detail: On Oct 20, 2026, Israeli strikes and gunfire killed seven Palestinians across Gaza, per civil defence and hospitals (AFP): two men in separate strikes in al-Zawaida and Wadi Gaza, one in Jabalia al-Balad, one Zeitoun victim taken to Al-Shifa, a man and woman in a strike on a residential block in al-Rimal near Al-Shifa Hospital, and a teenager shot south of Khan Younis (Nasser Hospital). The IDF named the man killed in al-Rimal as Akram Bassam Shaaban Yassin, a senior official in Hamas's general security apparatus; Al-Shifa identified him as Akram Yassin, killed with his wife. The IDF also said it killed a Hamas member involved in the abduction of Shani Louk on Oct 7, and said it was verifying other reports. Civil defence operates under Hamas authority; the IDF characterisation of Yassin is not independently verified.

media.caption: Mourners attend the funeral of Palestinians killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza City on October 20
